channel.name: NHK World JP
channel.title: Nun's Seasonal Calendar
channel.desc: Join us as we learn about life at the Otowasan Kannonji Temple through 24 terms from the solar calendar. First, we follow the nuns on the day of Seimei as they make yomogi rice cakes for the flower festival. Then, we watch as they try to dig up bamboo shoots on the day of Kokuu.
